text:
maria: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR for the v2 SDK migration guide and a short example update. Need reviews + merge ahead of the release cutoff this Friday. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/847

Tess: on it. I glanced at the SDK code snippet, one of the import paths is wrong for the new package namespace.

Tess: snippet

```
from redwood import InferenceClient  # -> should be from redwood_sdk.inference import Client
client = InferenceClient()
```

maria: thanks. I can fix the snippet and push an update. Also FYI the docs live under /docs/v2/migrations so we should version the TOC.

jordan: quick Q — is this gated by a feature flag? the runtime rollout for model-v2 is behind ff/model-v2 right?

lee: correct. Release plan: flip ff/model-v2 to gradual for 2h after deploy, then full. Docs should be merged before the flip so public examples match behavior.

sarah: release cutoff is Friday 17:00 PT. Prefer docs PR merged by 15:00 PT for CI previews and last-minute fixes.

ci-bot: netlify preview failed for PR #847 — build: broken-link-checker → 1 error

ci-bot: error: /docs/v2/migrations/index.md -> broken link to ../api/auth.md#token-rotation

maria: ahhh, that's the link fix I meant. I mistakenly used ../api/auth.md#token-rotation but the anchor changed in v2. I'll update to ../api/auth.md#rotating-tokens

Tess: PR updated with both SDK import fix and the link correction. Pushed commit 3f9b2d3

netlify-bot: New build triggered for PR #847 (commit 3f9b2d3) — preview: https://deploy-preview-847--docs.redwood-inference.netlify.app

netlify-bot: Build succeeded — no broken link errors. All checks green.

jordan: LGTM from infra side. Verified snippet matches the new pip package name.

lee: approve from PM. As long as netlify is green, we can merge at 14:50 PT to leave slack for rollouts.

sarah: I'll coordinate merging at 14:50 PT on Friday. @maria please hold the branch until then and don't squash the PR (we want the fix commits visible).

maria: got it. holding. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Tess: small follow-up — can we add a note in the migration guide about the new default timeout behavior? I'll open a tiny follow-up PR after the release.

maria: yes please. we'll include a short "after release" checklist in the docs repo.

jordan: re: observability links, I've added a reference to the rollout playbook in the PR comments — see runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/release-models

maria: perfect. I'll ping the release channel 10m before merge.

sarah: sounds good — thanks all!
